AI Overview
Traffic Rally is a browser-based 3D highway racing and driving game where you weave through dense traffic at high speeds. 
You can play it for free on platforms like Traffic Rally or 1Games. 
Game Modes
Traffic Rally features four distinct game modes: 
Career Mode: Complete 80 progressive levels with specific mission goals (such as maintaining speed or passing a set number of cars).
Infinite Mode: Drive as far as possible on a busy highway without crashing.
Time Against Mode: Race through traffic against a ticking clock to reach checkpoints.
Free Mode: Cruise and explore environments at your own pace without time limits or missions. 
Key Features
Vehicle Roster: Unlock and upgrade 22 different cars, ranging from compact starter cars to high-performance supercars and muscle cars.
Customization: Upgrade acceleration, handling, top speed, and braking, or tweak vehicle colors.
Environment & Weather: Navigate diverse routes including sunny city streets, desert roads, night drives, and rainy conditions that alter vehicle grip.
